expected_fix: Configure matching 'duplex full' and 'speed 100' (or enable 'duplex auto' / 'speed auto' on both ends) on SW2 FastEthernet0/24 and DS1 FastEthernet0/24.

Core-R2# show running-config | section line vty
line vty 0 4
 access-class ADMIN_SSH in
 transport input ssh
 login local

Core-R2# show access-lists ADMIN_SSH
Standard IP access list ADMIN_SSH
    10 permit 10.10.88.0, wildcard bits 0.0.0.255
expected_behavior: VTY lines should allow SSH connections from Admin-LAN 10.10.99.0/24.
actual_behavior: ACL ADMIN_SSH only permits 10.10.88.0/24, blocking SSH management attempts from 10.10.99.0/24.
expected_fault: VTY access-class ACL ADMIN_SSH permits wrong subnet 10.10.88.0/24 instead of Admin-LAN 10.10.99.0/24.
expected_fix: Add 'permit 10.10.99.0 0.0.0.255' to standard ACL ADMIN_SSH on Core-R2.

title: GRE Tunnel Path MTU Blackhole Dropping Large TCP Payloads
symptom: Ping works across the GRE tunnel, and SSH banner appears, but large file transfers or HTTPS pages stall indefinitely.
command_output:
R-SiteA# show interface Tunnel0
Tunnel0 is up, line protocol is up
  MTU 1476 bytes, BW 100 Kbit/sec, DLY 50000 usec
  Tunnel source 203.0.113.2, destination 198.51.100.2
  Tunnel protocol/transport GRE/IP

SiteA-Host> ping 10.20.2.10 -f -l 1472
Packet needs to be fragmented but DF set.
expected_behavior: TCP segments with Don't Fragment (DF) bit set should adjust MSS to fit inside the 1476-byte GRE tunnel MTU.
actual_behavior: 1500-byte DF packets fail over Tunnel0 (MTU 1476) because PMTUD ICMP fragmentation-needed messages are dropped or MSS exceeds 1436 bytes.
expected_fault: GRE encapsulation overhead reduces effective Tunnel0 MTU to 1476 without TCP MSS clamping, causing Path MTU blackholing for DF TCP traffic.
concept: TCP MSS Clamping & Path MTU Discovery
expected_fix: Configure 'ip tcp adjust-mss 1436' (or 1400) and 'ip mtu 1476' on Tunnel0 on both R-SiteA and R-SiteB.

-- Inside Source

expected_behavior: Dynamic PAT translations should have available ephemeral ports and zero allocation failures.
actual_behavior: Active translations reached 64512 with 48210 allocate failures, exhausting single-IP PAT session capacity.

concept: Session State Tracking & PAT Port Exhaustion
expected_fix: Expand the NAT pool with additional public IP addresses (or reduce stale TCP session timeouts) so PAT port allocation does not exhaust.

title: AAA TACACS+ Session Timeout and Fallback Misconfiguration
symptom: Administrators are locked out or experience hanging VTY login prompts whenever the central TACACS+ server is unreachable.
command_output:
Core-SW1# show running-config | include aaa
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default group tacacs+
aaa authorization exec default group tacacs+

Core-SW1# ping 10.10.99.50
Success rate is 0 percent (0/5)
expected_behavior: AAA login should fall back to the local user database when the TACACS+ server is unreachable.
actual_behavior: AAA authentication list specifies 'group tacacs+' with no 'local' fallback method, locking out administrative sessions during TACACS+ outage.
expected_fault: Missing 'local' fallback in AAA authentication method list while TACACS+ server 10.10.99.50 is unreachable.
expected_fix: Update AAA configuration to 'aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local' and verify connectivity to TACACS+ 10.10.99.50.

title: TLS Certificate Expiration and Cipher Suite Rejection
symptom: Browsers and API clients report SSL/TLS handshake failure when connecting to internal portal https://portal.corp.local, though TCP port 443 accepts SYN.
command_output:
Client> openssl s_client -connect 10.30.5.20:443
CONNECTED(00000003)
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
notAfter=Jan 14 23:59:59 2025 GMT
SSL-Session:
    Protocol  : TLSv1
    Cipher    : EXP-RC4-MD5
    Verify return code: 10 (certificate has expired)
expected_behavior: Server should present a valid, non-expired X.509 certificate and negotiate TLS 1.2/1.3 strong ciphers.
actual_behavior: TLS handshake fails verification due to expired certificate (notAfter Jan 14 2025) and legacy TLSv1/RC4 cipher.
expected_fault: Expired X.509 SSL/TLS certificate and deprecated TLSv1/RC4 cipher configuration on 10.30.5.20:443.
expected_fix: Renew and install a valid X.509 certificate on 10.30.5.20 and disable TLS 1.0/RC4 in favor of TLS 1.2/1.3.

title: Internal DNS Resolution Failure Returning NXDOMAIN
symptom: Users cannot open http://erp.corp.local by hostname, even though pinging the server IP 10.40.10.20 succeeds immediately.
command_output:
User-PC> ping 10.40.10.20
Reply from 10.40.10.20: bytes=32 time=2ms TTL=63

User-PC> nslookup erp.corp.local
Server:  dns1.corp.local
Address: 10.10.1.53
*** dns1.corp.local can't find erp.corp.local: Non-existent domain

User-PC> ipconfig /all
DNS Servers . . . . . . . . . . . : 10.10.1.53
expected_behavior: DNS server 10.10.1.53 should resolve erp.corp.local to 10.40.10.20.
actual_behavior: IP connectivity to 10.40.10.20 works, but nslookup against 10.10.1.53 returns Non-existent domain (NXDOMAIN) for erp.corp.local.
expected_fault: Missing or deleted DNS A-record for erp.corp.local on authoritative DNS server 10.10.1.53.
concept: DNS Name Resolution & Application Layer Lookup
expected_fix: Create/restore the DNS A-record mapping erp.corp.local to 10.40.10.20 on DNS server 10.10.1.53.
